_comment_purpose: TEMPLATE: gate-record-template.json — one immutable record of a single gate decision (ai_review, sec_review, or human_review) applied to one RD. Copy this file per gate event as gate-records/<gate_id>.json. Audit finding N5 (2026-07-29): this shape is aspirational — no command in commands/ currently writes gate-records/*.json this way. Real practice (confirmed against production gate-records/*.json) uses three simpler shapes instead: flat phase-level records (PB<n>-*.json), flat RD-level DOR records (RD-*-dor.json), and a differently-shaped nested RD-level gate record (RD-*-gate.json, per /cz:gate step 7) with fields rd_id/cycle/order_enforced/ai_review/security_review/gate_decision — none of which use gate_id/rd/gate_type/ts. schemas/gate-record.schema.json was reconciled to describe those three real shapes rather than this one; this template's shape was left as-is (not deleted) as a reference for a possible future single-gate-per-file redesign, but do not treat it as what /cz:gate actually produces today — see /cz:gate step 7 and gate-records/RD-*-gate.json for the real shape.
_comment_gate_id: Format: GATE-<rd-id>-<nn> where <nn> is a zero-padded sequence number, incrementing per RD across ALL gate events on that RD (ai_review, sec_review, human_review share one sequence). e.g. the 2nd gate event ever recorded on RD-PB0X-012.03 is GATE-RD-PB0X-012.03-02.
_comment_rd: The RD id (bare, no @version — the gate applies to whichever version was current at gate time; see rd_version_at_gate below).
_comment_rd_version_at_gate: The RD's version number at the moment this gate ran, so the record stays meaningful even if the RD is later re-versioned.
_comment_reviewer: Agent id for ai_review/sec_review, or a human name/email for human_review.

checklist_results.item: No non-atomic read-modify-write on shared reconciliation state
checklist_results.note: Nightly refresh reads last-reconciled figures then writes new ones in two separate steps with no lock — a concurrent retry can interleave and produce partial revenue, which is exactly what AC-PB0X-012.03-1 forbids.

checklist_results.item: Input validation rejects malformed rows before write

_comment_checklist_results: verdict above should be 'fail' if ANY item here is 'fail' unless explicitly waived — record the waiver in note.
_comment_human_approved: MUST be settable ONLY by an actual human — hooks/guard-role-boundaries.sh blocks any agent-authored write of true to this field, regardless of gate_type or verdict.
_comment_understanding_gate_answered: True only once the Understanding Gate question below has a human-authored answer logged in deliverables/understanding-log/rd/<rd-id>.md (or the relevant phase fragment under deliverables/understanding-log/ for a phase-level gate) BEFORE this gate can reach verdict: pass at the human_review step.
understanding_gate_question: REPLACE_ME - the question the human must answer to close this gate, e.g. "Why does atomic write-or-nothing matter here more than in a low-traffic admin screen?"
_comment_understanding_gate_answer: Must be human-authored, not AI-generated. null until answered.
_comment_ts: ISO8601 UTC timestamp of when this gate decision was recorded.
